notes: Partition verified: 20 source and 34 target tokens each covered once across 20 units, with no `added` unit.

The second clause has no ordinal noun in Hebrew: the Piel שִׁשִּׁיתֶם itself means *give the sixth part of*, so *ye shall give the sixth part* is one unit headed on the complement (rules 17, 44). A competing reading would leave *the sixth part* unattached, but no other morpheme licenses it.
Every article on אֵיפָה and on the grain nouns is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing *an ephah*, *of wheat* and *of barley* without a *the* (rule 29).
